light: oil lamps low on both sides (warm, from below); cool daylight from the opening in the left wall at the foot; the upper doorway faintly warm
note: People on the ramp are exactly the size the picture is drawn for. On the level floor at the foot (rows 500 to 600) the picture's own perspective is a little steeper, so a figure at the very bottom edge is about a tenth small for the stone round it: not noticeable.

the first, big slot in the right-hand bench (mirror place 1)
the top of the tall step under the upper doorway (mirror place 2)
builders' marks in red ochre on the right-hand wall: a levelling line, its triangle, tallies, a gang's sign
oil jars, spare lamp dishes and a lit lamp, on the floor against the left-hand bench
a ladder leaning in the near left corner (front plane)
an old sledge runner laid along the right-hand bench
a gold-banded chest on carrying poles and two jars of white stone, set down on the right-hand bench halfway up
beer jars and a basket of bread left on the left-hand bench
a coil of rope on the floor by the level bench

exits.what: the low passage that comes in from outside: the lit opening in the left wall
the small doorway above the tall step at the top of the ramp
